messages:
vikram: Quick heads-up — seeing steady RSS growth from kv-cache in prod when long chat sessions run with prefix reuse on. Repro on staging. Posting heap diff + short profile snapshot.

sara: can you paste the pprof? :eyes:

vikram: paste:
```
heap: in_use 3.2GB -> 4.8GB over ~90m
live_objects 1.2M -> 1.9M
alloc_retainers: 60% kv.prefix_shard_map, 25% kv.entry_payloads
top callsites: kv.InsertOrUpdate, kv.prefetchHandler
```

ben: is this a leak or just growing residency because of sticky prefixes?

vikram: looks like residency. evictions don't appear to keep up. lots of small prefix entries (~1-3KB) multiplying instead of plateauing.

perf-bot: alert: kv-cache-residency-high on prod-cluster-3 (inst abcd1234) :warning:

jess: quick hypothesis: key variance. subtle differences in conv_id/headers create many distinct keys so reuse fails and residency grows.

sara: can you grep request logs for inconsistent key forms? maybe a new client started sending a nonce.

vikram: did that — found ~0.8% of requests had conv_id with trailing whitespace or mixed case. small fraction but at scale explains steady growth.

ben: fix path: normalize conv_id & tenant before keying, plus per-tenant cap and sliding TTL on prefix buckets.

jess: sketch for keying change:
```
normalized_conv = lower(trim(conv_id))
prefix_fp = sha1(normalize(prefix_text))[:12]
kv_key = sha256(tenant_id + '|' + normalized_conv + '|' + prefix_fp)
```
Add: per-tenant LRU cap (max_prefix_per_tenant=10k), sliding_ttl=15m.

vikram: another factor: eviction scanner runs 1s/shard and our "pin" for sticky sessions is refreshed every request. for long sessions the pin never decays so entries never evict.

sara: that pin behavior was to avoid tail latency on re-used sessions. maybe change pin to token-based (pin_count) or limit refresh frequency.

ben: alternate: keep time-based pin but only refresh on same-conv fingerprint AND if delta_since_last_use > 50ms to avoid tight-loop refresh.

jess: note: changing keying alters hit/miss patterns which can shift batching and kernel-selection hot paths — need latency and cost monitoring during rollout.

vikram: rollout plan:
- PR: key normalization + prefix_fp + per-tenant cap (vikram)
- Add metrics: cache_duplicate_rate, per_prefix_residency_seconds, prefix_eviction_count, prefix_pin_refreshes (sara)
- Canary: 5% traffic + replay harness longctx 2h (ben)
- Kernel smoke: capture kernel_choice distribution pre/post (jess)

sara: wiring metrics now. suggest gates: duplicate_rate < 0.1%, residency plateaus within 30m, eviction_rate >= 30/min/shard.

ben: during canary, also coalesce batching for identical prefix_fp within 50ms window to reduce redundant prefetches. small change, big win for hot prefixes.

vikram: added repro script for staging: `./tools/replay_longctx --conv replay-123 --count 2000` (simulates long session with slight conv_id variants).

perf-bot: scheduled nightly heap-diff on staging for 3 runs; will post results.

jess: implementation note: need migration path for dedicated caches — dual-lookup for 24h: check new_key then legacy_key then re-insert under new_key. tag migration_hit=true.

vikram: agreed. dual-lookup in canary mode. instrument migration_hit ratio.

sara: I'll add dashboard widgets: kv.prefix_residency.p50/p99, kv.dup_rate, kv.migration_hit_ratio, kernel.choice_breakdown.

ben: I'll own canary rollout + batching tweak. target tomorrow 09:00 PT.

vikram: checklist in PR: unit+integration tests, staging run, metric gating, rollback steps.

jess: add unit test simulating header-order and casing changes to assert normalized keys collapse.

vikram: added to checklist. reconvene after 4h canary with metrics. :thumbsup:

sara: filing followups: GH #repo/1234 (normalization), #repo/1235 (eviction-pin-change), #repo/1236 (canary).

vikram: will post canary metrics in thread. thanks everyone.
